summary.text: Stacey Donato is a Republican who has represented Indiana Senate District 18, which covers Cass, Fulton and Miami counties and portions of Howard and Kosciusko counties, since 2019.
She is the ranking member of the Family and Children Services Committee and is an accountant.

paragraphs.text: According to her Indiana Senate Republican biography, Donato attended Ivy Tech Community College and served on the Cass County Council at large.
She also sits on the Commerce and Technology, Education and Career Development, Elections, Pensions and Labor, and Utilities committees.

The page lists her activities as including the Grissom Air Force Reserve Base Community Council, the Logansport/Cass County Rotary Club, the Cass County 4-H executive committee and the Advisory Board of the Logansport/Cass County Airport Authority.
It identifies her as Catholic, married to Jim, with two children.
